title: [spec-gap][R-10-014] pkt_id correlation IDs absent in Rust and C stacks (spec 16.8.1/16.8.3)
description: Spec 10-implementation.md 16.8.1/16.8.3: pkt_id MUST be present on all log lines in the packet processing path; each node maintains a monotonic wrapping u32 counter, assigned at the link-layer RX entry for received frames and at TX queue push for locally originated packets; pkt_id is local-only (never on the wire); forwarded packets receive a new pkt_id and SHOULD log event=forward in_pkt_id=<rx> pkt_id=<tx>. Classification: divergent — Python reference implementation exists, Rust and C have nothing. Evidence Python: node-wide shared counter link_layer.py:1551-1554 + tx_queue.set_pkt_id_source (python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py:334-336); RX assignment before auth stamping link_layer.py:1701,1730; TX push assignment tx_queue.py:291-296,412; packet-path logs carry pkt_id (node.py:915-1428); forward/relay logs in_pkt_id (node.py:1104,1163, not the exact spec format); local-only: stamped post-auth via object.__setattr__ (link_layer.py:1730), accessor frames.py:136-138. Evidence Rust: grep pkt_id over rust/ -> 0 matches. Evidence C: grep pkt_id over lichen/ -> 0 matches. Covers rows R-10-014, R-10-019, R-10-020, R-10-021 of docs/spec-coverage/10-implementation.md (R-10-020 vacuously satisfied in Rs/C, thin in Py). Suggested placement: adopt the Python model (shared counter, RX-entry + TX-push assignment, local-only metadata) in rust/lichen-node and lichen/subsys/lichen/link; coordinate with the logfmt bead (b7z9.133) since fields land together; decide the exact forward-format question flagged as F-3 in 10-implementation-flagged.md.
